name: Improved Spell Critical
body:
Choose one type of spell for which you have already selected the Weapon Focus feat. Your critical hits with that spell type are more deadly than normal.

Prerequisite: Spell Critical, Weapon Focus (ray or touch), Spellcraft 11 ranks

Benefit: When you confirm a critical hit with a spell of the selected type, your spell deals triple damage.

Normal: Critical hits with spells deal double damage.
